name: DirectCase Legal Search
description:
Legal analysis with citations in minutes.

DirectCase is an AI legal-research tool that searches verified legal sources across national and European law and adds a concrete source to every statement, citing the case number or the specific section. Open the original with a single click.

For lawyers, attorneys, and judges who need fast, thorough analysis of legal cases.

It understands the hierarchy of legal texts and finds even the rare, one-off decisions.

The content of your queries is not used to train AI. Communication is encrypted, our servers are in the EU, and we meet GDPR requirements. You can delete your queries completely at any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DirectCase Legal Search to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DirectCase Legal Search to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.directcase.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DirectCase Legal Search MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DirectCase Legal Search lists 16 MCP tools, including convert_file_to_markdown, currency_conversion, get_current_time, get_document, get_entitlements, get_law_detail, legislation_changes, search_caselaw_parallel, search_company, search_company_documents, search_identifier, and search_keyword.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DirectCase Legal Search?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DirectCase Legal Search in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.

_published_faq.name: Does DirectCase Legal Search MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: DirectCase Legal Search requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DirectCase Legal Search is developed by DirectCase s.r.o.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
